title: La Jolla Whole House Remodel
summary: Comprehensive whole-house remodel and modest addition that reconfigured the home's interior around a modern courtyard while updating the exterior with clean contemporary detailing and expansive new glazing.
description: This La Jolla residence received a complete interior and exterior transformation while maintaining the original footprint wherever practical. The project included a 396-square-foot addition, extensive interior reconfiguration, updated finishes, and permit-ready construction documents.

The redesign emphasizes indoor-outdoor living with a remodeled courtyard, expanded living spaces, a new primary suite, updated kitchen, and contemporary exterior elevations that create a cohesive modern appearance.
